notes: Original upstream direct prompt requests concise answer with no explanation/citations; rubric penalizes shorter answers. Difficulty is operational under this prompt/judge.
Median split rule: high >= median, low < median; ties may unbalance group sizes.
Three independent judge draws, dimension medians; failed final judgments NA=5. Ten E1 direct answers reused.
NA=5. Per-question total is sum of three-draw dimension medians. All 48 included in main.
E1 pilot scores reused without new sampling; full source and judge artifacts preserved by symlink.
Question round-robin four-arm concurrency; judge follows incrementally with four separate workers.
Token counters are client-observed prompt_tokens (including cache) / completion_tokens, same as E1; failures without usage are unknown.
Citation checks cover .py references, suffix resolution and explicit colon/# line ranges, not truth of cited claims.
Category intervals are descriptive only; n=1 location stratum gives degenerate resampling interval.

bootstrap.method: paired differences percentile bootstrap; category group means likewise percentile bootstrap; no multiplicity claims
